title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
# ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF

Bitcoin's down 2.7% to $71,629—clean rejection at resistance. Fear & Greed at 29 shows capitulation mood, but here's what matters: hashrate holding steady at 1,007 EH/s means miners aren't panicking despite margin compression. That's structural strength underneath the noise.

On-chain signal worth watching—mempool's relatively lean at 84,751 transactions. That suggests we're not seeing panic liquidations cascading through the network. Base fee sitting at 8 sat/vB is cheap.
